t: Complete kit specifically designed for the safe and efficient clean-up of chemical spills, providing fast and reliable response in hazardous situations. Includes chemical absorbent socks constructed using a spunbond outer layer, maximising tensile strength, liquid retention, and long-term durability. Also in the kit, chemical absorbent pads, perforated for controlled usage and made from high-loft meltblown polypropylene fibres, ensuring excellent absorbency performance and strength. A compact clip-top bag allows for easy storage, handling, and transport, while the durable clear bag features bold labelling for quick identification during emergencies. This single-use kit is intended for immediate deployment, ensuring responders can act quickly and effectively when spills occur.
